title: Lead magnet and inbound capture flow

gates.text: Truth: no benchmark data, survey result, store or customer count, testimonial, turnaround, capacity or outcome that isn't in confirmed facts or cited research. Gaps are marked [NEEDS FACT: ...].

Consent: plain-language statement of what the lead will receive; marketing consent never pre-ticked; separate opt-in where EU/UK rules require; consent evidence fields specified; inbound leads routed only to a consented nurture lane, never cold outreach.
Honesty: no promised results, no fake scarcity on free items, no confirmshaming or other dark patterns in the form or pop-ups.
Completeness: includes the magnet spec, its name, the capture page and form, delivery (email 1) and a nurture hand-off outline.

anchors.1: 'Ultimate guide' or broad topic with no concrete outcome.
anchors.5: One concrete outcome for one buyer, stated in the name with format and specifics.
Pre-purchase job named from VOC, FAQs or sales calls, with the source stated.

anchors.1: Generic information a chatbot could produce.
anchors.3: Some of the business's own data or examples.
anchors.5: Proprietary tool, data, sample, access or personalised result only this business can offer.

anchors.1: Unrelated to what the business sells.
anchors.3: Loosely related; next step left to the lead.
anchors.5: Using it naturally leads to buying, with the next step built into the asset (pre-filled order, 'book the fix').

anchors.1: Long PDF or course needing an hour or more.
anchors.5: Value in under 5 minutes; result shown on screen.

anchors.1: Many fields, value fully gated, aggressive pop-ups.
anchors.3: Reasonable form, no preview of value.
anchors.5: Minimum fields, partial result before the gate, outcome button, instant delivery.

anchors.3: Generic 'send a newsletter' and 'share on social'.
anchors.5: 4–6 email outline tied to the magnet topic with exit on purchase, source tagging, and specific placements where buyers already are.

anchors.3: Opt-ins tracked, no link to revenue.
anchors.5: Funnel tracked through to customers and revenue per lead by magnet; benchmarks labelled directional.
